The sphere is carved from a cube of the smallest possible side, so the sphere must fit inside the cube and touch all six faces. That makes the cube's side equal to the sphere's diameter, 6 inches, and its volume 6³ = 216 cubic inches.

Solution A makes an error. It sets the cube's space diagonal equal to the sphere's diameter. That would put the sphere's diameter at the cube's corners, so the sphere would be circumscribed around the cube, not carved out of it. Solution B has the correct setup and answer.

WINNER: B
